# Marriott Bonvoy

> > Marriott Bonvoy is the global hotel loyalty program offering access to 9,000+ hotels and vacation rentals across 30+ brands including The Ritz-Carlton, St. Regis, JW Marriott, W Hotels, and Sheraton.

Marriott International operates the world's largest hotel portfolio spanning luxury, premium, and select service properties. The platform enables direct booking with best rate guarantees, member-exclusive benefits, and travel rewards across iconic brands like The Luxury Collection, Edition Hotels, and Homes & Villas by Marriott Bonvoy.

- [Marriott Bonvoy Hotels | Book Directly & Get Exclusive Rates](https://www.marriott.com/default.mi): Homepage for Marriott Bonvoy with 9000+ hotels and vacation rentals
- [Marriott Brands | Marriott Bonvoy Hotel Brands](https://www.marriott.com/brands.mi): Portfolio directory of Marriott Bonvoy luxury and select hotel brands
- [Wonderful Hotels & Resorts | Marriott Hotels](https://marriott-hotels.marriott.com/): Marriott Hotels brand page featuring properties and loyalty benefits

## Booking Policies & Guarantees

- [Marriott | OUR BEST RATE. GUARANTEED](https://www.marriott.com/online-hotel-booking.mi): Best rate guarantee policy and direct booking benefits information
